scripts.test: rm -rf blob-report && (PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=parallel.zip playwright test --project=parallel --pass-with-no-tests; a=$?; PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=exclusive.zip playwright test --project=exclusive --pass-with-no-tests; b=$?; playwright merge-reports --reporter=html ./blob-report; exit $((a || b)))
scripts.test:smoke: rm -rf blob-report && (PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=parallel.zip playwright test --project=parallel --grep @smoke --pass-with-no-tests; a=$?; PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=exclusive.zip playwright test --project=exclusive --grep @smoke --pass-with-no-tests; b=$?; playwright merge-reports --reporter=html ./blob-report; exit $((a || b)))
